meaning.en: Time passes quickly and cannot be recalled.
meaning.zh: 时间过得很快，一去不复返。

examples.zh: 光阴易逝，我们更应该珍惜眼前的每一天。
examples.en: Time slips away, so we should treasure every day we have.

examples.zh: 毕业二十年了，才真正体会到光阴易逝的道理。
examples.en: Twenty years after graduating, I finally understand how quickly time passes.

usage.en: Often a sigh in writing or speeches urging people to value time; usually a standalone clause.
usage.zh: 多用于书面语或演讲，感叹时间飞逝、提醒人们珍惜，常单独成句。

literal: hardworking · bear hardship · bore into · study

meaning.en: To study a subject or problem diligently and in depth, putting in great effort.
meaning.zh: 不怕辛苦，深入细致地学习、研究某门学问或某个问题。

examples.zh: 他刻苦钻研数学，终于在竞赛中获奖。
examples.en: He studied mathematics with great dedication and finally won a prize in the competition.

examples.zh: 这位工程师刻苦钻研技术，解决了不少难题。
examples.en: The engineer worked hard to master the technology and solved many difficult problems.

usage.en: Verb phrase; often followed by an object (刻苦钻研业务) or used as a modifier (刻苦钻研的精神).
usage.zh: 动词性短语，后可带宾语，也可作定语，如“刻苦钻研的精神”。

meaning.en: Having the same goals and aspirations.
meaning.zh: 理想和追求一样。

examples.zh: 他们志向相同，毕业后一起创办了公司。
examples.en: They shared the same ambitions and set up a company together after graduating.

examples.zh: 志向相同的人更容易成为朋友。
examples.en: People with the same aspirations find it easier to become friends.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often explains why people work or stay together.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常用来说明人们走到一起的原因。

meaning.en: Holding the same view; being in agreement.
meaning.zh: 看法相同，没有分歧。

examples.zh: 经过讨论，大家意见一致，决定下周出发。
examples.en: After discussion everyone agreed and decided to set off next week.

examples.zh: 两位专家的意见一致，认为方案可行。
examples.en: The two experts were of one mind that the plan is workable.

usage.en: Predicate; common in meetings and reports (双方意见一致).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于会议和报告，如“双方意见一致”。

literal: not a bit · have none · way · method

meaning.en: To have no way at all of dealing with a situation.
meaning.zh: 一点办法也没有。

examples.zh: 面对突然的停电，我们毫无办法。
examples.en: Faced with the sudden power cut, we were completely helpless.

examples.zh: 孩子不肯吃饭，妈妈毫无办法。
examples.en: The child refused to eat and his mother didn't know what to do.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows 对／拿 … (对他毫无办法).
usage.zh: 作谓语，常说“对／拿……毫无办法”。

meaning.en: The sun shines brightly and the weather is lovely.
meaning.zh: 阳光灿烂，景色宜人。

examples.zh: 周末阳光明媚，我们决定去公园野餐。
examples.en: The weekend was bright and sunny, so we decided to have a picnic in the park.

examples.zh: 在阳光明媚的早晨出发，心情格外好。
examples.en: Setting off on a sunny morning put us in an especially good mood.

usage.en: Describes weather or a day; predicate or attributive (阳光明媚的春天).
usage.zh: 描写天气或日子，作谓语或定语，如“阳光明媚的春天”。

meaning.en: Writing that is splendid and full of literary flair.
meaning.zh: 文章辞藻华美，很有文学才华。

examples.zh: 这篇散文文采斐然，读来令人陶醉。
examples.en: This essay is brilliantly written and a delight to read.

examples.zh: 他虽是理科生，却文采斐然。
examples.en: Though he studies science, he writes with real flair.

usage.en: Praises a writer or a piece of writing; predicate or attributive. Fairly formal.
usage.zh: 称赞作者或文章，作谓语或定语，较书面。

meaning.en: Plants and trees growing thick and luxuriant.
meaning.zh: 花草树木长得繁茂旺盛。

examples.zh: 雨季过后，山谷里草木茂盛，一片翠绿。
examples.en: After the rainy season the valley was lush and green.

examples.zh: 这片草木茂盛的湿地是鸟类的家园。
examples.en: This lush wetland is home to many birds.

usage.en: Describes scenery; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 描写景物，作谓语或定语。

natural: bright moon high in the sky

meaning.en: A bright moon hanging in the sky.
meaning.zh: 明亮的月亮高挂在天空。

examples.zh: 明月当空，我们坐在院子里聊天。
examples.en: With a bright moon overhead, we sat chatting in the courtyard.

examples.zh: 中秋夜，明月当空，全家人一起赏月。
examples.en: On Mid-Autumn night, under a bright moon, the whole family gazed at it together.

usage.en: Scenic or poetic description of a night; often a standalone clause.
usage.zh: 描写夜景，带诗意，常单独成句。

meaning.en: To make extremely rapid progress.
meaning.zh: 进步非常快。

examples.zh: 她学了半年中文，进步神速。
examples.en: She has learned Chinese for half a year and is progressing remarkably fast.

examples.zh: 老师夸他进步神速。
examples.en: The teacher praised him for his rapid progress.

usage.en: Predicate, often after a person as subject; a compliment about learning or skills.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多以人作主语，常用来夸奖学习或技能。

meaning.en: To differ enormously; the gap between two things is very large.
meaning.zh: 彼此差别极大。

examples.zh: 两队实力相差悬殊，比赛毫无悬念。
examples.en: The two teams were so unevenly matched that the result was never in doubt.

examples.zh: 城乡收入相差悬殊。
examples.en: Incomes in town and country differ enormously.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows 双方／两者 or a subject plural; common in news.
usage.zh: 作谓语，主语多为“双方、两者”等，新闻中常见。

synonyms: 小拇指比大腿——差一大截

meaning.en: Streams flowing with a soft, gurgling sound.
meaning.zh: 溪水流动，发出轻柔的响声。

examples.zh: 山间流水潺潺，空气格外清新。
examples.en: A brook babbled in the hills and the air was wonderfully fresh.

examples.zh: 我们在流水潺潺的小溪边休息了一会儿。
examples.en: We rested a while by a gently babbling stream.

usage.en: Scenic description; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 描写景物，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: To be faithful to one's duties and carry them out conscientiously.
meaning.zh: 忠诚地对待并坚守自己的岗位和职责。

examples.zh: 消防员忠于职守，始终坚守在救援一线。
examples.en: The firefighters stayed true to their duty and remained on the front line of the rescue.

examples.zh: 他忠于职守三十年，从未请过一天假。
examples.en: He devoted himself to his post for thirty years without taking a single day off.

usage.en: Praise for officials, soldiers and workers; predicate or attributive; formal.
usage.zh: 称赞干部、军人、职员等，作谓语或定语，较正式。

meaning.en: Being short of money and finding it hard to make ends meet.
meaning.zh: 钱财不够用，生活窘迫。

examples.zh: 那几年家里经济拮据，他只好边读书边打工。
examples.en: The family was short of money in those years, so he worked while studying.

examples.zh: 公司经济拮据，已经发不出工资。
examples.en: The company is financially strapped and can no longer pay wages.

usage.en: Predicate; fairly formal, in news and writing. 拮据 is rarely used on its own.
usage.zh: 作谓语，较书面，见于新闻和文章；“拮据”很少单用。

meaning.en: Full of endless enjoyment.
meaning.zh: 有无尽的快乐和趣味。

examples.zh: 养花种草，乐趣无穷。
examples.en: Growing flowers and plants brings endless pleasure.

examples.zh: 孩子们在沙滩上玩得乐趣无穷。
examples.en: The children had endless fun playing on the beach.

usage.en: Predicate, often after an activity (…乐趣无穷); also 其乐无穷.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常放在某项活动之后；也说“其乐无穷”。

meaning.en: To be overwhelmed with grief.
meaning.zh: 悲伤痛苦到了极点。

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她极度悲痛，几乎晕倒。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news she was overcome with grief and nearly fainted.

examples.zh: 家属极度悲痛，请大家给予理解。
examples.en: The family are devastated; please be understanding.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; common in news about bereavement.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，多见于有关亲人逝世的新闻。

meaning.en: To be in an awkward or embarrassing position, with no easy way out.
meaning.zh: 所处的情况让人为难、不好应对。

examples.zh: 夹在父母和妻子之间，他处境尴尬。
examples.en: Caught between his parents and his wife, he was in an awkward spot.

examples.zh: 公司处境尴尬，进退两难。
examples.en: The company's position is awkward; it can neither advance nor retreat.

usage.en: Predicate; 尴尬 is gān gà. Often followed by a reason or by 进退两难.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“尴尬”读 gān gà，后面常接原因或“进退两难”。

meaning.en: Being closely connected, whether as people or as matters.
meaning.zh: 彼此联系紧密，往来多，感情或关联深。

examples.zh: 两国经贸关系密切。
examples.en: The two countries have close trade ties.

examples.zh: 睡眠质量与健康关系密切。
examples.en: Sleep quality is closely related to health.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; can describe people or abstract matters; 与……关系密切.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，可指人，也可指事物，常说“与……关系密切”。

meaning.en: Looking full of vigour and spirit.
meaning.zh: 精力充沛，情绪饱满。

examples.zh: 睡足八小时，第二天精神饱满。
examples.en: After a good eight hours' sleep, he was full of energy the next day.

examples.zh: 队员们精神饱满地走上赛场。
examples.en: The players walked onto the pitch in high spirits.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (精神饱满地…); a common compliment on someone's look.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，如“精神饱满地……”，常用来夸人状态好。

meaning.en: Living in poverty, with barely enough to get by.
meaning.zh: 日子过得很穷，难以维持温饱。

examples.zh: 战争让许多家庭生活贫困。
examples.en: The war left many families living in poverty.

examples.zh: 他从小生活贫困，却一直很乐观。
examples.en: He grew up in poverty yet has always been cheerful.

usage.en: Predicate; also used as an attributive (生活贫困的家庭).
usage.zh: 作谓语，也可作定语，如“生活贫困的家庭”。

meaning.en: Being in a very difficult situation.
meaning.zh: 所处的情况非常困难。

examples.zh: 疫情期间，许多小店处境艰难。
examples.en: During the epidemic many small shops were in a tough spot.

examples.zh: 他在新公司处境艰难，没人愿意帮他。
examples.en: He was in a hard position at the new firm, and nobody was willing to help.

usage.en: Predicate; 处 here is chǔ. Often says what a person or group is facing.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“处”读 chǔ，常说明某人或某群体面临的困难。

meaning.en: Being on close, warm terms with someone.
meaning.zh: 彼此感情好，来往密切。

examples.zh: 他们俩关系亲密，像亲兄弟一样。
examples.en: The two are very close, like brothers.

examples.zh: 父子关系亲密的家庭，孩子更有安全感。
examples.en: Children feel more secure in families where father and son are close.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; about people (unlike 关系密切, which also suits matters).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多指人与人之间（“关系密切”还可指事物）。

meaning.en: Having a firm, unwavering will.
meaning.zh: 决心大，不动摇。

examples.zh: 她意志坚定，不管多难都不放弃。
examples.en: She is strong-willed and never gives up, however hard it gets.

examples.zh: 意志坚定的人更容易达成目标。
examples.en: People with firm resolve find it easier to reach their goals.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praises a person's character.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，称赞人的品质。

meaning.en: Having a deep and lasting bond of affection.
meaning.zh: 彼此感情很深。

examples.zh: 两人是多年的老朋友，感情深厚。
examples.en: They are old friends of many years and share a deep bond.

examples.zh: 他对故乡感情深厚。
examples.en: He is deeply attached to his hometown.

usage.en: Predicate; about friends, family or a place.
usage.zh: 作谓语，可指朋友、亲人，也可指对某地的感情。

meaning.en: Full of energy and able to work or play without tiring.
meaning.zh: 精神和体力充沛。

examples.zh: 孩子们精力旺盛，一整天都在跑来跑去。
examples.en: The children are full of energy and ran about all day.

examples.zh: 七十岁了，他依然精力旺盛。
examples.en: At seventy he is still full of vigour.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; about people and sometimes animals.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于人，有时也用于动物。

meaning.en: Having a great deal of practical experience.
meaning.zh: 有很多实际经历和经验。

examples.zh: 这位医生经验丰富，很快找到了病因。
examples.en: The doctor is highly experienced and soon found the cause.

examples.zh: 公司想招一位经验丰富的会计。
examples.en: The firm wants to hire an experienced accountant.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (经验丰富的…); common in job ads.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，如“经验丰富的……”，招聘广告中常见。

meaning.en: Taking no interest in worldly affairs; living apart from the world.
meaning.zh: 不过问社会上的事情，不关心外界。

examples.zh: 他退休后隐居山中，不问世事。
examples.en: After retiring he lived in the mountains, taking no interest in worldly affairs.

examples.zh: 一心读书的她几乎不问世事。
examples.en: Absorbed in her books, she paid almost no attention to the world outside.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or mildly critical, depending on context.
usage.zh: 作谓语，可中性，也可带轻微批评，视语境而定。

meaning.en: Having no fixed whereabouts; hard to track down.
meaning.zh: 去向没有规律，不容易找到。

examples.zh: 他常出差，行踪不定，很难约到。
examples.en: He travels a lot and is always on the move, so he is hard to pin down.

examples.zh: 警方发现嫌疑人行踪不定。
examples.en: The police found that the suspect had no fixed whereabouts.

usage.en: Predicate; 行 here is xíng. Often used for people who travel or evade contact.
usage.zh: 作谓语；“行”读 xíng，常指经常外出或有意躲藏的人。

literal: continuous · carry on · not · break off

meaning.en: Going on continuously, without a break.
meaning.zh: 一个接着一个，没有中断。

examples.zh: 这几天连续不断地下雨。
examples.en: It has rained without a break these past few days.

examples.zh: 连续不断的噪音让人无法入睡。
examples.en: The continuous noise made it impossible to sleep.

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial (连续不断地…) or attributive.
usage.zh: 作谓语、状语（连续不断地……）或定语。

meaning.en: To waste effort on something that achieves nothing.
meaning.zh: 花了力气却没有任何结果。

examples.zh: 别去劝他了，只是白费力气。
examples.en: Don't try to persuade him; you'd only be wasting your breath.

examples.zh: 原来是同一个问题，我们白费力气折腾了半天。
examples.en: It was the same problem all along, and we wasted hours of effort.

usage.en: Verb phrase; the 气 in 力气 is neutral tone. Often after 只是／不过是.
usage.zh: 动词性短语；“力气”的“气”读轻声，前面常有“只是、不过是”。

synonyms: 孙悟空跳不出如来佛的手心——枉费心机

meaning.en: Having great ambitions and far-reaching aims.
meaning.zh: 理想和抱负高远宏大。

examples.zh: 这个年轻人志向远大，想改变家乡的面貌。
examples.en: This young man has lofty ambitions and wants to transform his hometown.

examples.zh: 志向远大的人不会只看眼前。
examples.en: Those who aim high do not look only at what is in front of them.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise, often of young people.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，是褒义，多说年轻人。

meaning.en: To put right a mistake or fault.
meaning.zh: 把做错的事、说错的话纠正过来。

examples.zh: 知道错了就要及时改正错误。
examples.en: If you know you are wrong, correct the mistake promptly.

examples.zh: 他承认了问题，并保证改正错误。
examples.en: He admitted the problem and promised to put it right.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; often after 勇于／及时／认真.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，前面常有“勇于、及时、认真”等。

meaning.en: A warm, lively atmosphere in which people take part eagerly.
meaning.zh: 场面活跃，大家情绪高涨。

examples.zh: 会场上气氛热烈，掌声不断。
examples.en: The atmosphere in the hall was lively, with applause throughout.

examples.zh: 宴会气氛热烈，大家举杯祝贺。
examples.en: The banquet was lively, and everyone raised a glass to toast.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for meetings, parties and matches. 气氛 is qì fēn.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于会议、聚会、比赛等；“气氛”读 qì fēn。

literal: not a bit · not · spend · effort

meaning.en: Without taking any effort; done with ease.
meaning.zh: 一点儿力气也不用花，很轻松。

examples.zh: 他毫不费力地举起了那箱书。
examples.en: He lifted the box of books without any effort.

examples.zh: 这对她来说毫不费力。
examples.en: It takes her no effort at all.

usage.en: Usually adverbial with 地 (毫不费力地…) or predicate.
usage.zh: 多作状语（毫不费力地……），也可作谓语。

meaning.en: Having no sense of shame; behaving disgracefully without embarrassment.
meaning.zh: 不懂得羞愧，做了丑事也不觉得难为情。

examples.zh: 他撒了谎还不知羞耻，反而指责别人。
examples.en: He lied and, shameless as ever, even blamed others.

examples.zh: 这种不知羞耻的行为应当受到谴责。
examples.en: Such shameless behaviour deserves condemnation.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; a strong criticism.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，批评意味较重。

meaning.en: Having a lofty, pure character.
meaning.zh: 品格高尚，操守清白。

examples.zh: 老校长人品高洁，深受大家敬重。
examples.en: The old headmaster was a man of noble character and widely respected.

examples.zh: 她人品高洁，从不占别人便宜。
examples.en: She is of high moral character and never takes advantage of others.

usage.en: Praise for a person, formal; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 称赞人，较书面；作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: To bring trouble upon oneself through one's own actions.
meaning.zh: 自己给自己招来烦恼和困难。

equivalents: make a rod for one's own back

examples.zh: 明知道有风险还去做，不是自找麻烦吗？
examples.en: Doing it when you know the risks, isn't that asking for trouble?

examples.zh: 别多管闲事，免得自找麻烦。
examples.en: Don't meddle, or you will only bring trouble on yourself.

usage.en: Colloquial; often in rhetorical questions or warnings. 麻烦 is má fan.
usage.zh: 口语，常用于反问或劝告；“麻烦”读 má fan。

meaning.en: Not afraid to sacrifice oneself, even one's life, for a cause.
meaning.zh: 为了正义或集体，不害怕付出代价甚至生命。

equivalents: fearless in the face of death

examples.zh: 战士们不怕牺牲，勇敢地冲向敌阵。
examples.en: The soldiers, unafraid to die, charged bravely at the enemy line.

examples.zh: 救援人员不怕牺牲，第一时间赶到现场。
examples.en: The rescuers, ready to risk everything, reached the scene at once.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 不怕困难 in speeches and reports.
usage.zh: 作谓语，演讲和报道中常与“不怕困难”连用。

meaning.en: Doing things carelessly, without attention to detail.
meaning.zh: 做事不认真，不仔细。

examples.zh: 他做事马虎，作业里错字连篇。
examples.en: He works carelessly, and his homework is full of wrong characters.

examples.zh: 做事马虎的人容易出差错。
examples.en: People who are careless are prone to mistakes.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 马虎 is mǎ hu.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语；“马虎”读 mǎ hu。

meaning.en: To gather strength quietly in preparation for the future.
meaning.zh: 积累实力，为以后做准备。

examples.zh: 球队利用休赛期积蓄力量，准备下个赛季。
examples.en: The team used the off-season to build up strength for the next season.

examples.zh: 这几年他一直在积蓄力量，等待机会。
examples.en: He has been building up his strength these years, waiting for a chance.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; often followed by 等待时机 or 再出发.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，后面常接“等待时机、再出发”之类。

meaning.en: To wait for the right moment to act.
meaning.zh: 耐心等候合适的机会再行动。

examples.zh: 现在条件不成熟，我们只能等待时机。
examples.en: The conditions aren't ripe, so we have to bide our time.

examples.zh: 他耐心等待时机，终于抓住了机会。
examples.en: He waited patiently for the right moment and finally seized the chance.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; often paired with 积蓄力量.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常与“积蓄力量”并用。

meaning.en: Impressive in scale and spirit; having a commanding presence.
meaning.zh: 规模和声势很大，令人震撼。

examples.zh: 开幕式气势宏大，给观众留下深刻印象。
examples.en: The opening ceremony was grand and left a deep impression on the audience.

examples.zh: 这座气势宏大的建筑群吸引了众多游客。
examples.en: This imposing complex of buildings attracts many visitors.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for buildings, performances, music and so on.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，可形容建筑、演出、音乐等。

meaning.en: Competition that is intense, with many people vying for a few places.
meaning.zh: 争夺很厉害，对手很多。

examples.zh: 这个行业竞争激烈，利润越来越薄。
examples.en: Competition in this industry is fierce, and margins keep getting thinner.

examples.zh: 名校录取竞争激烈。
examples.en: Admission to top schools is highly competitive.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; common in business, exams and sports news.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，商业、考试和体育报道中常见。

meaning.en: Having a striking, commanding air or force.
meaning.zh: 声势或气派不同一般，很有威力。

examples.zh: 大瀑布气势非凡，从高处倾泻而下。
examples.en: The great waterfall is magnificent, plunging from on high.

examples.zh: 乐队一出场就气势非凡。
examples.en: The band made a striking entrance, full of power.

usage.en: Predicate; for scenery, people, performances or teams.
usage.zh: 作谓语，可形容景色、人物、演出或队伍。

meaning.en: To give oneself up to pleasure without restraint.
meaning.zh: 毫无节制地追求享受。

examples.zh: 他继承遗产后整日纵情享乐，很快挥霍一空。
examples.en: After inheriting a fortune he indulged in pleasure all day and soon squandered it.

examples.zh: 不能只顾纵情享乐而忘了责任。
examples.en: One must not give oneself over to pleasure and forget one's responsibilities.

usage.en: Verb phrase with a critical tone; contrast with 勤俭节约.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，带批评意味，与“勤俭节约”相对。

meaning.en: A taste or feeling that lingers long afterwards.
meaning.zh: 事物留给人的回味久久不散。

examples.zh: 这杯茶入口微苦，却余味悠长。
examples.en: The tea is slightly bitter at first but leaves a long, lingering aftertaste.

examples.zh: 这首诗短小，余味悠长。
examples.en: The poem is short but lingers in the mind.

usage.en: Used for tea, wine, food, poems, music and films; predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 可形容茶、酒、食物、诗歌、音乐和电影，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: To look back on things that happened in the past.
meaning.zh: 回过头来想从前的事。

examples.zh: 回首往事，他感慨万千。
examples.en: Looking back on the past, he was filled with emotion.

examples.zh: 每当回首往事，她都会想起那位老师。
examples.en: Whenever she looks back, she thinks of that teacher.

usage.en: Verb phrase, usually opening a sentence of reflection.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常放在句首引出感慨。

literal: what one has seen · experience · rich · abundant

meaning.en: Having seen and experienced much of life.
meaning.zh: 见过的世面多，人生经历多。

equivalents: with a wealth of life experience

examples.zh: 他走遍世界各地，阅历丰富。
examples.en: He has travelled all over the world and has a wealth of experience.

examples.zh: 阅历丰富的老人给年轻人许多建议。
examples.en: The worldly-wise old man gave the young people plenty of advice.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; stresses life experience, whereas 经验丰富 stresses skill at a job.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，侧重人生见识；“经验丰富”侧重工作技能。

meaning.en: A region rich in natural and agricultural products.
meaning.zh: 出产的东西种类多、数量大。

examples.zh: 云南物产丰富，素有“植物王国”之称。
examples.en: Yunnan is rich in produce and is known as the 'kingdom of plants'.

examples.zh: 这里地大物产丰富，人民生活富足。
examples.en: The land here is vast and bountiful, and the people live well.

usage.en: Describes a region; predicate or attributive. Often with 地大／土地肥沃.
usage.zh: 描写某个地区，作谓语或定语，常与“地大”“土地肥沃”连用。
